articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
articles.snippet: Seven more issuers have opted out of being listed on the planned tokenized stock venue under the SEC's framework, bringing its disclosed objection count to 16.

articles.title: South Korean IPO slump adds to AI market jitters as Brent crude tops $111
articles.snippet: Elice’s debut slump added to concerns over AI infrastructure valuations, while rising oil prices compounded market uncertainty.

articles.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
articles.snippet: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

articles.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
articles.snippet: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

articles.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.
